@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+from app.webhooks.delivery import deliver_with_retry
+
+def test_retries_on_5xx(monkeypatch):
+    sleeps = []
+    statuses = [500, 502, 200]
+    monkeypatch.setattr("app.webhooks.delivery.deliver",
+                        lambda url, body: statuses.pop(0))
+    monkeypatch.setattr("app.webhooks.delivery.sleep", sleeps.append)
+    status, attempts = deliver_with_retry("http://x", {})
+    assert (status, attempts) == (200, 3)
+    assert sleeps == [2, 4]
+
+def test_does_not_retry_4xx(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr("app.webhooks.delivery.deliver", lambda u, b: 404)
+    status, attempts = deliver_with_retry("http://x", {})
+    assert (status, attempts) == (404, 1)
output:
test(webhooks): unit-test retry backoff with injected sleep

Confirms 5xx retries with 2s/4s delays, stops on success after
three attempts, and client errors are not retried.

+import json, logging
+from app.logging.formatter import JsonFormatter
+
+def test_formats_as_json():
+    record = logging.LogRecord("app", logging.INFO, "x.py", 1,
+                               "hello %s", ("world",), None)
+    out = json.loads(JsonFormatter().format(record))
+    assert out["msg"] == "hello world"
+    assert out["level"] == "INFO"
+
+def test_includes_exception():
+    try:
+        raise ValueError("boom")
+    except ValueError:
+        import sys
+        record = logging.LogRecord("app", logging.ERROR, "x.py", 1,
+                                   "failed", None, sys.exc_info())
+    out = json.loads(JsonFormatter().format(record))
+    assert "boom" in out["exc"]

test(logging): assert JSON formatter output and tracebacks

Parses formatted lines back to JSON to guarantee valid, indexable
log records, including exception text.
